content.short: Whales Liquid Pool lets users stake TON and receive wsTON, a liquid staking token usable in DeFi.
content.description: Whales Liquid Pool is a liquid staking pool from TON Whales. The pool lets users deposit TON for staking and receive wsTON, whose value increases as staking rewards accrue while the token remains transferable or swappable on DEXs. It gives TON holders staking exposure without locking all utility of the underlying asset. Стейкайте TON и получайте ликвидные токены стейкинга (wsTON), которые можно торговать, получая при этом награды.
